en: Color postcard showing the ornate Neo‑Renaissance Peleș Castle with tall spires, timbered and stone facades, ivy on the walls, terraces and statues, formal gardens with visitors, and forested mountains in the background. The reverse has Romanian layout text "CARTE POȘTALĂ," publisher credit Editura Meridiane, multilingual captions naming the castle, a price in lei, and photo credit.
